entities.summary: Jessa Crispin is a critic, author, feminist, and the editor-in-chief of Bookslut, a litblog and webzine founded in 2002. She has published five books, most recently What is Wrong with Men: Patriarchy, the Crisis of Masculinity, and How Michael Douglas Films Explain Everything (2025).
